text: answer[mkt-1789181063783-6a6159]: Evidence rating: 8/10 for the conclusion that Jeffrey Epstein died by suicide; 3/10 for claims that he was murdered. On August 10, 2019, Epstein was found unresponsive in his cell at the Metropolitan Correctional Center in New York. The city medical examiner ruled hanging by suicide, and the DOJ inspector general’s 2023 report found severe failures: missed checks, falsified records, excess linens, broken or unavailable camera systems, and Epstein being left alone. Those failures explain how suicide could occur and why suspicion persists, but they do not establish homicide. An independent pathologist hired by Epstein’s family disputed some neck-injury interpretations, yet that disagreement is not proof of murder. The strongest evidence supports suicide enabled by extraordinary institutional negligence; no publicly verified evidence conclusively demonstrates assassination.
